stories.narrEn: According to Dawn, the Bank of England (BoE) raised its benchmark interest rate to four per cent on Thursday, the first increase in more than three years, as soaring energy costs push up global inflation. According to The New York Times, the central bank increased interest rates for the first time in more than three years and warned that inflation would climb to about 5 percent next year, far above its target. According to BBC, the interest rate set by the Bank of England affects mortgage, loan and savings rates for millions. According to Bloomberg, the Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee raised interest rates for the first time since 2023 in a bid to bear down on soaring inflation.

stories.narrEn: NPR reports: Wong was sentenced for his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law, in a case that critics say reflects the crackdown on the city's once-thriving pro-democracy movement. Le Monde reports: Wong, a former student leader who became internationally renowned during the 2014 Umbrella Movement, was accused of foreign collusion, a national security offense. According to CNA, jailed since 2020, Joshua Wong will be 40 when he is released under his latest sentence.
